missing_information_behavior: If any required context is unknown, do not issue a positive recommendation; request clarification or professional review.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer zinc deficiency from vegan status; check fortified foods and current supplements; avoid excess chronic zinc.
professional_escalation_conditions: Known deficiency, malabsorption, pregnancy, chronic disease or concurrent high-dose zinc/copper imbalance.
population_and_context: Vegan adults with potentially lower zinc bioavailability due to phytate-rich dietary patterns; dietary context only.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose; total zinc intake and UL must be considered.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Zinc fact sheet discusses bioavailability, phytate and upper limits; diet alone does not establish deficiency. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
